mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of joint decline events, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annually, it signals a risk of inflation overshoot, prompting market expectations of future rate hikes, which depress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction starts above 580,000 units after two consecutive months below 570,000 signals a recovery in housing demand, which boosts confidence in the broader economy and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 580.0 after two consecutive months < 570.0
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of joint events, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 350,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue forecasts and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
